answer: Require stake-backed, gradually earned trust: each agent locks a small refundable deposit and gains full voting power only after a history of verified useful work. A newcomer is throttled, like a falcon on a short creance until it proves it returns reliably. An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must fund every deposit and wait out the same slow ramp, so cost scales with each forgery while an honest user pays once. Reused cipher keys or copied histories are detectable, and proven duplicates lose their stake and are extinguished like a lantern snuffed out.
